name: Hair Salon Bookings
tagline: Slot picked, booking made, record created
description: For hair salons, barber shops and spas: set up your stylists' slots, let customers pick only a free slot over WhatsApp, the bot or the booking page, and every booking becomes a record on its own.

automations.name: Booking received
automations.emailMessage: {customer_name} ji, aapki booking mil gayi — {appointment_date} ko {slot_time} baje, {stylist} ke saath. Jald confirm karte hain. ✂️
automations.note: A confirmation to the customer as soon as the slot is booked

automations.name: Booking confirmed
automations.emailMessage: {customer_name} ji, aapki appointment confirm hai — {appointment_date}, {slot_time}. Milte hain!
automations.note: A firm confirmation to the customer once the booking is confirmed

automations.name: Thank you after the visit
automations.emailMessage: Thank you {customer_name} ji! Kaisa laga? 1-5 me rating bhej dijiye. 💇

automations.name: Cancelled — slot free
automations.emailMessage: {customer_name} ji, aapki booking cancel kar di gayi hai. Nayi booking kabhi bhi kar sakte hain.
automations.note: Tell the customer when a booking is cancelled

whatsappTemplates.name: appointment_confirmed
whatsappTemplates.bodyText: Hi {{1}}, your appointment is confirmed for {{2}} at {{3}} with {{4}}. See you soon!

whatsappTemplates.name: appointment_reminder
whatsappTemplates.purpose: Remind the customer a day before
whatsappTemplates.bodyText: Hi {{1}}, a reminder for your appointment tomorrow at {{2}}. Reply RESCHEDULE if you need another time.

whatsappTemplates.name: feedback_request
whatsappTemplates.purpose: Ask for feedback after the visit
whatsappTemplates.bodyText: Hi {{1}}, hope you loved your new look! Reply with a rating 1-5 — it helps us serve you better.

agent.name: Booking Assistant
agent.persona: You are a warm salon receptionist. Share services, prices and timings from the knowledge. To book, take the customer's name and phone, then offer ONLY the slots listed in AVAILABLE SLOTS and book the one they choose with the book_slot action. Never invent a time, a stylist or a price, and never promise a slot that is not on that list.
agent.welcomeMessage: Hi! Would you like to book an appointment? Tell me the service you want and I'll share the free slots.

stageHints.hint: the customer confirms the slot and the service
the customer says they cannot come or wants to cancel

playbook.goal: Fill the diary: turn every enquiry into a booked slot, keep the customer reminded, and bring them back after the visit.

rules.name: Booking not confirmed
rules.message: Hi {customer_name}, shall I confirm your appointment on {appointment_date} at {slot_time}? Reply YES.

rules.name: Feedback after the visit
rules.message: Hope you loved your new look! Reply with a rating 1-5 — it helps us improve.

rules.name: Unhappy customer → manager
rules.message: AI sentiment is negative. A manager should call this customer.
